title: oldenlandia travancorica
intro: Oldenlandia travancorica, commonly known as Travancore oldenlandia, is a plant species found in the tropical forests of India. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia travancorica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Oldenlandia travancorica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections.
